facts.text: I am looking for advice on choosing a new camera bag.
I narrowed my camera bag options to the Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW and the Think Tank Urban Disguise 40L.
I use my camera mostly for portrait and low-light photography.
I have issues with my old 18-55mm kit lens.
I have been relying on manual focus lately.
I recently got a new 50mm prime lens.
I want a bag that can protect my gear well.
I want to carry my Nikon D5600 and a few lenses, including the 50mm prime, in the camera bag.
I am considering getting a new tripod to replace my old Manfrotto BeFree.
My Manfrotto BeFree tripod is starting to show signs of wear and tear.
I want a sturdy and durable tripod that can support my Nikon D5600 and lenses.
I have been looking at Gitzo and Really Right Stuff tripods.
I have not considered the Manfrotto MT057CXPRO4 yet.
I am planning to upgrade my camera body to a full-frame model like the Nikon Z6 in the future.
I am thinking about getting a remote shutter release for my camera.
I have been thinking about getting a neutral density filter to help with my photography.
